neighbours.label: the ordinal suffix 'th' after a numeral, especially in centuries and historical units (19th century, 18th Regiment)
fire: The town grew rapidly during the 19th century as the railways arrived.
He served as a private in the 18th Regiment during the war.
Many of these churches were built in the 15th and 16th centuries.
The custom dates back to the 12th century in northern France.
The bridge was rebuilt in the 17th century after a great flood.
Our 14th president is rarely mentioned in school textbooks.
The castle was abandoned in the 18th century and fell into ruin.
Printing spread across Europe in the late 15th century.
quiet: The town grew rapidly during the 1860s as the railways arrived.
He served as a private in the Royal Regiment during the war.
Many of these churches were built in the late Middle Ages.
The custom dates back to the year 1150 in northern France.
The bridge was rebuilt in 1680 after a great flood.
Our early presidents are rarely mentioned in school textbooks.
The castle was abandoned around 1750 and fell into ruin.
Printing spread across Europe after the year 1450.

notes: 'th' x11 of the top 32 (19th, 18th); other peaks are digits of years and Napoleon. Near misses keep the history topic but write years or spelled-out dates without a numeral+th.
